[[Staff Sergeant/Legends|Staff Sergeant]] '''Rothax''' was a member of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] [[Galactic Marines/Legends|Galactic Marines]].

==Biography==
During [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]], Staff Sergeant Rothax was stationed in the [[Talus/Legends|Talus]] [[Talus Imperial Outpost|Imperial Outpost]], where he offered weapons and armor to Imperials who served valiantly in battle.

He was rumored to have given a sword to an unknown Imperial that was similar, or in fact the same as the [[Sword of Ajunta Pall]].

==Behind the scenes==
Rothax is a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|Non-Player Character]] (NPC) in the [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|MMORPG]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]''. He was added to the game in Game Update 10 as part of the new Player versus Player battlefields. He offers a variety of weapons and armor to Imperial players who fight consistently on the battlefields.
